verdict.rationale: Microsoft Graph provides a substantial API surface for Teams (messaging, channels, teams/channel creation, export, webhooks) with a live, schema-documented endpoint (ms-teams-probe-5, ms-teams-docs-8/11/19/21), but a community report explicitly notes 'API integration requires the full Azure/Graph API stack unlike Slack's simple webhooks' (ms-teams-comm-11), and there's no evidence that UI-only actions like meeting/call controls, presence, reactions, or full chat UX parity are exposed via API. missing for 10: API coverage for meeting/calling features, reactions/presence parity, evidence that all UI actions map 1:1 to API calls, independent confirmation beyond one critical community note.
